Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
The binding volume commitment is set out below; would that provide the clarity you need for planning? We understand you are fully booked and that delivery time and a firm commitment matter to you, and we appreciate the formal approval process for larger price steps. Our proposal offers a long contract term for planning security, and our forecast demand for this part is rising; payment terms are fixed for this agreement.

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 29.95 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your should-cost estimate and historical order data have been noted. 

We agree to the proposed volume of 23400 units, the 36-month contract term, and the 56-day lead time. In consideration of this extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving on your offer; we appreciate your flexibility and understand that your pricing reflects your costs. Our long contract term offers planning security, and our demand forecast for this part is rising; we have also moved our proposal toward you again. The binding volume we can commit to is set out below.

We confirm a binding volume of 23400 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 31.22 per unit, 23400 units a year, 36 months, lead time 56 days.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
